tagline: Shoma omu ndimi zoona. Guma oine oburemeezi bukye.
selectionHint: Toorana ekigambo, sentensi nari akacweka. Noobaasa n’okuteera aha rubaju rwa buryo.
appHint: Envunuura z’omu nkora niziteebwa omu nkora zitari aha Intaneeti. Ebimwe nibivunuurwa omu byoma. Amaziina g’endimi nigakuratira orurimi rwa app orutoorainwe.
fallback: Bing yaremwa, gyezaho Google (eyohereza ebihandiiko ahari Google)
dynamicHint: Ebirikureebeka nibyo birikwebembezibwa. Reka kurekura abareeberezi.
languageReset: Orurimi orurikubanza tiruriho aha ingini egi; okutoorana orurimi kuhindwirwemu.
message1: Koodi y’orurimi teine mugasho. Koresa id, en, ja, zh-CN, n’ebindi.
message3: Yijuza ekishumuruzo kya API y'omuhi w'obuheereza omu ntebeekanisa.
message4: Yijuza ID y’omuringo gw’omuhi w’obuheereza omu ntebeekanisa.
message6: Orikuha obuheereza tarikugaruza envunuura. Reeba eky’okureeberaho, orurimi, n’ekicweka.
message8: Batch teine ​​mugasho nari ni mpango munonga.
message9: Omubaro gw'ebyarugamu bya Bing batch tigurikushushana.
message10: Ebirugire omu batch ya Bing tibiine mugasho.
message12: Ebihandiiko ebitarimu kintu kyona nari enyuguta ezirikurenga 12,000.
message34: Omuhi w’obuheereza naahindura omuringo gw’okuhandiikaho. Block y’okubanza neegumaho.
message38: Obubonero nibubura aha byarugamu. Block y’okubanza neegumaho.
message43: Orupapura rwona nirukorwa omu bicweka ebirikushushana.
message44: Omuhi w'obuheereza akaremwa omu bicweka 3. Nyiga translate kugyezaho kugaruka.
message49: Ekikomo ky'okwijuka ebiri omu kihikire. Garuraho orupapura otakagumizamu.
message58: Garuka oteho extension reero ogarukye oteho orupapura kubaasa kutaho version ensya.
message61: Garuka ohandiike aha rupapura rwawe kyaba kiri eky’okwongyeramu ekisya.
message65: Yeshereka kuhisya obu orupapura ruragarukye busya
